title: Improve DCERPC SVCCTL interface support
description:
Improve DCERPC SVCCTL interface support

This commit replaces the hand written parser with PIDL generated SVCCTL parser. In addition to that, it improves the number of operations that are supported by wireshark.

Example, this PR adds support for `CreateServiceWOW64W (45)`
https://github.com/401trg/detections/blob/master/pcaps/20171220_smb_psexec_add_user.pcap
![image](/uploads/83e1f3c6c146c35e394acfdab6246af1/image.png)
